name: superb
description: Personal skill collection. Skills are invoked as superb:<skill>. craft turns a vague product idea into a decision-rich CRAFT.md brief — it questions, challenges and records, and deliberately stops short of planning. pipeline takes a settled idea to a finished branch, composing the superpowers skills with a zero-assumption question law, on-disk run state, two approval gates, reviewer fan-out, a recursive fix loop, and dependency waves for parallel implementers.
